exit_state: Collateral recovery closes without recognizing the debtor's collateral twice or forgiving the legal claim. Revolving capacity,fee purpose,partial transfers,guarantees and options each require their own evidence and measurement. Retained option exposure is the difference between separately presented asset and liability. The funding example now distinguishes capacity,request and confirmed receipt,with three settlement histories preserving unpaid deposits and lost-acknowledgement uncertainty.

The revolving schedule retains original credit history and remeasures funded and undrawn losses;neither nominal draw percentage nor a cancellation clause supplies the missing exposure model.

Call,put and collar equations reconstruct retained exposures,including the full put value. The amortised-cost comparison correctly uses distinct asset and liability yields.
Funding capacity is not cash. Confirmed receipts8,6 and0 produce different unpaid deposits while preserving the same equity20. No new confirmed local defect.
